name: fullstack-react-fastapi
description: Opinionated fullstack web app: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript frontend, Python 3.13+ FastAPI backend, AWS ECS Fargate + CDK deployment
constitution_principles: Frontend components never import directly from backend modules; all data crosses the API boundary via HTTP.
FastAPI route handlers in backend/api/ are thin wrappers only — validate input, call a service in backend/core/, return a response. No business logic in route handlers.
Server state lives in React Query. Local UI state lives in Zustand or useState. Never duplicate server state in the client store.
Pydantic models define the API contract. Zod schemas on the frontend mirror them. When either changes, the other changes in the same commit.
Secrets are never committed. Use .env for local development and SSM Parameter Store for production.
Infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK) is confined to iac/cdk/; application code never imports CDK constructs, and infrastructure code never imports application business logic.

starter_rules.prevents: business logic and persistence access leaking into FastAPI route handlers
triggers: route handler file under backend/api/ contains database queries, ORM access, or non-trivial computation
plan or implementation adds logic directly inside a route function instead of a service
starter_rules.rule: FastAPI route handlers in `backend/api/` are thin wrappers only: validate input, call a function in `backend/core/`, return a response. Business logic and data access belong in `backend/core/`.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review edits under `backend/api/` for ORM/database driver imports, direct DB queries, or logic that belongs in a service or core module. The executable hook blocks persistence/ORM imports under `backend/api/`.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Route handler delegates to `backend/core/`. The core function owns the logic and data access and is independently testable.

starter_rules.prevents: the React frontend importing backend modules instead of crossing the API boundary
triggers: frontend file imports from backend/ (api, core, data)
frontend reaches into backend internals instead of calling the HTTP API
starter_rules.rule: The frontend communicates with the backend only through the published HTTP API. Frontend modules must not import from `backend/`.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review imports under `frontend/` for paths into `backend/`. The executable hook blocks backend imports from frontend files.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Frontend `services/` call FastAPI endpoints over HTTP (Axios) and depend only on shared, transport-safe contract types (Zod schemas mirroring Pydantic models).

starter_rules.prevents: server state duplicated or manually synced in a client-side Zustand store
triggers: Zustand store under frontend/src/stores/ holds data fetched from an API endpoint
frontend code copies or syncs server response data into a local store
starter_rules.rule: Use React Query for all server state (fetching, caching, mutations). Use Zustand only for UI-only state that does not come from the server (sidebar open, modal visibility, local preferences).
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review Zustand stores for API access. The executable hook blocks `axios`, React Query, or `fetch(` usage inside `frontend/src/stores/`.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: API data lives in a React Query query or mutation result; components call `useQuery`/`useMutation`. Data is never copied into a Zustand store.

starter_rules.prevents: frontend and backend drifting from the agreed data contract
triggers: Pydantic response model is changed without a corresponding Zod schema update
frontend TypeScript type is defined manually without mirroring the API contract
starter_rules.rule: Pydantic models define the API contract. Zod schemas on the frontend must mirror them. Both sides change in the same commit when the contract changes.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Cross-file, same-commit invariant — not enforced by the single-edit hook. Reviewed during at-implement/at-plan: a Pydantic model change must ship with a matching Zod schema change in the same diff.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Change Pydantic model and Zod schema together. If `openapi-typescript` or similar generation is configured, regenerate and commit the output.

starter_rules.prevents: AWS CDK / infrastructure code leaking into the application and application logic leaking into infrastructure
triggers: application file under frontend/ or backend/ gains an `aws_cdk` or `constructs` import
iac/ module imports application business logic from backend/core/
starter_rules.rule: Confine AWS CDK constructs to `iac/cdk/`. Application code must not import `aws_cdk`; infrastructure code must not import application business logic.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: The executable hook blocks `aws_cdk`/`constructs` imports under `frontend/` and `backend/`, and blocks `backend/core` imports under `iac/`.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Infrastructure (ECS Fargate service, networking, secrets) is declared in `iac/cdk/`. The backend ships as a container image and is deployed by the stack; the two communicate through configuration and environment, not shared imports.
